correction: The V1 review's claim that the selected provider response is cell-specific was incorrect.

source_evidence.finding: For each contest, response_logits[name] is baseline response_intercept plus race[i], and response[name] is a scalar sigmoid. CountsRules multiplies this scalar by the cell-specific candidate_probability tensor and broadcasts the noncandidate share across the 24x12 cells. The allocation therefore has cell-varying intensity/utility profiles but one response value per contest.

revised_assessment.source_fidelity: The oracle's single response argument used uniformly across profiles matches the pinned selected provider's per-contest response scalar. With each profile given the actual cell-intensity weight, candidate probability, and shared noncandidate simplex, its deterministic conditional allocation equations are faithful to the fixed-input source allocation; common eventG can be included as a common multiplier in profile weights.
revised_assessment.withdrawn_finding: Withdraw the claim that the selected source response is cell-specific, and withdraw the characterization of the scalar oracle response as a source-equation gap.
revised_assessment.heterogeneous_response_probe: The retained response=0.9/0.1 counterexample (43/7 versus 7/3) remains mathematically valid for a hypothetical model with profile-varying response. It is not evidence of a limitation in the pinned 117-components provider and should not be used to challenge this oracle's source fidelity.
remaining_limits: Oracle values/profiles are invented; no selected model state or actual 288-cell values were passed.
The oracle establishes a deterministic allocation identity, not inference, posterior behavior, historical source/label correctness, or causal layer contribution.
Use cell intensity/profile weight and expected category marks terminology; these expected marks are not an independently measured physical turnout total.
At fixed event scale, intensity, and response, candidate roster expansion redistributes named marks rather than changing total named-category mass.
revised_assessment.verdict: No source-equation blocker remains in the declared fixed-profile scope. The V1 response-shape criticism is retracted. All non-source-fidelity limits in V1 remain.

no_model_or_owner_work: Read-only source inspection and correction only; no model import/run, raw outcome rows, Arizona tuning, owner data changes or new fit.
